title: Wrong property layer
signal: Answer uses true property rule at wrong transaction stage.
student_move: Ask whether chain is at contract, deed, mortgage, title, ownership, or use-right stage.
trap: True deed rule before closing; recording rule before valid delivery; remedy before a right exists.
confidence: HARD for order; ANCHOR-ASSISTED for rule at link

title: Status pair
signal: Two answers assign opposite legal statuses to same person or interest.
student_move: Name the pair and locate splitting fact.
trap: Picking familiar phrase instead of status supported by stem.

title: First effective link
signal: Later priority/remedy competes with earlier validity/status defect.
student_move: Source → status → event → anchor → consequence.
trap: Jumping to legally sophisticated downstream answer.

title: Property anchor floor
signal: Parallel well-formed array; no wrong-layer defect.
student_move: Apply small anchor.
trap: Calling RAP, PMM priority, deed delivery, AP period, fixture classification structure.

title: Wrong Closing Layer
signal: Answer uses contract, marketability, deed, or warranty language at wrong stage.
student_move: Ask whether closing occurred and whether deed acceptance changed governing layer.
trap: True deed rule before closing or true contract rule after merger.
confidence: HARD STRUCTURAL for sequence; ANCHOR-ASSISTED for merger exceptions

title: Remedy Before Breach
signal: Answer jumps to deposit, damages, or specific performance before breach.
student_move: Identify enforceability and title/disclosure breach before remedy.
trap: Remedy language feels practical and attractive.
confidence: HARD STRUCTURAL for order; ANCHOR-ASSISTED for remedy rule

title: Marketable / Unmarketable Title
signal: Finalists disagree over buyer refusing to close.
student_move: Classify alleged defect: private encumbrance, cloud, zoning, building defect, easement, covenant.
trap: Treating every property problem as marketability defect.

title: Disclosure / No Disclosure
signal: Survivors disagree over seller/lessor duty to reveal defect.
student_move: Check known, latent, material, not readily discoverable.
trap: As-is or inspection treated as automatic defeat.

title: Contract → Closing → Deed
signal: Choices mix contract enforceability, marketability, deed merger, warranties, remedies.
student_move: Run enforceable contract → pre-closing title/disclosure → closing/deed → merger → remedy.
trap: Choosing familiar property rule instead of controlling stage.
confidence: HARD STRUCTURAL for stage order; ANCHOR-ASSISTED for each rule

title: Land-Sale Anchor Floor
signal: Parallel well-formed array; no wrong-stage defect.
student_move: Escalate to SOF, part performance, marketability, equitable conversion, merger, disclosure.
trap: Pretending equitable conversion, part performance, or marketability classification is structure.

title: Debt/Security Collapse
signal: Answer treats personal liability and foreclosure exposure as the same.
student_move: Split into who owes debt and what land secures debt.
trap: Not liable sounds like not affected, but land can still be foreclosed.
confidence: HARD STRUCTURAL when categories collapse; ANCHOR-ASSISTED for assumption rule

title: Mortgagee-as-Owner Trap
signal: Answer speaks as if mortgagee is ordinary owner.
student_move: Treat mortgage as security unless title-theory/possession fact supplied.
trap: Security interest translated into full ownership.

title: Assumption / Subject-To Pair
signal: Finalists disagree over grantee personal liability.
student_move: Find promise-to-pay fact.
trap: Buying mortgaged land assumed to mean assuming debt.

title: Senior / Junior / Proceeds Pair
signal: Finalists disagree over priority, foreclosure effect, surplus, deficiency.
student_move: Build lien ladder before choosing.
trap: Jumping to fairness/debtor before ordering liens.

title: The Mortgage Ladder
signal: Choices mix debt liability, lien priority, foreclosure, proceeds.
student_move: Run note → mortgage → transfer → assumption/subject-to → priority → foreclosure → proceeds → deficiency.
trap: Answering wrong layer because it sounds like correct mortgage rule.
confidence: HARD STRUCTURAL for ladder order; ANCHOR-ASSISTED for rung rule

title: Mortgage Anchor Floor
signal: Parallel well-formed array; no debt/land/priority collapse.
student_move: Apply mortgage anchor.
trap: Calling PMM priority, statutory redemption, fixtures, or equitable mortgage structure.

title: Wrong Current Status
signal: Answer assigns consequence to someone not current legal status-holder.
student_move: Name status first.
trap: Physical possessor treated as full owner.

title: Possession ≠ Title
signal: Answer treats occupancy/use/control as ownership change.
student_move: Separate possession from title.
trap: Possession feels like ownership.
confidence: HARD for co-tenant possession; ANCHOR-ASSISTED otherwise

title: Remedy Before Status
signal: Answer jumps to rent/taxes/partition/reimbursement before classifying ownership.
student_move: Classify status before remedy.
trap: Fairness hides wrong status.

title: Estate / Status Pair
signal: Finalists classify same person/interest differently.
student_move: Name pair and status-changing event.
trap: Picking familiar legal phrase instead of event.

title: Joint Tenancy / Tenancy in Common
signal: Answers fight over survivorship, devise, severance, creditor effect.
student_move: Ask whether JT existed and whether severed before death/transfer.
trap: Treating co-ownership language as enough.

title: Assignment / Sublease Pair
signal: Answers fight over transfer liability/privity/term.
student_move: Check whole remaining term vs retained reversion.
trap: Every transfer treated as assignment.

title: Status Before Consequence
signal: Choices mix legal status and remedy.
student_move: Source → status → event → anchor → consequence.
trap: Correct consequence attached to wrong person.
confidence: HARD for sequence; ANCHOR-ASSISTED for status rule

title: Event Must Actually Change Status
signal: Answer assumes event changed ownership.
student_move: Ask whether event legally changed status.
trap: Any major event treated as transformative.

title: Estate and Co-Ownership Floor
signal: Parallel well-formed answer array.
student_move: Escalate to life estate, remainder, JT/TIC, severance, partition, duties.
trap: Calling technical estate classification structure.

title: RAP / Option / Future-Interest Floor
signal: Choices are valid/invalid or vested/contingent.
student_move: Identify interest then use RAP/future-interest anchor.
trap: Future-interest word leads to assumed result.

title: Wrong Use-Right Home
signal: Answer names wrong land-use doctrine category.
student_move: Classify right before enforcement.
trap: Neighbor use makes doctrines interchangeable.

title: Remedy Before Right
signal: Answer jumps to remedy.
student_move: Ask whether right exists and binds this party before remedy.
trap: Correct remedy for wrong category.
confidence: HARD for order; ANCHOR-ASSISTED for creation

title: Public / Private Restriction Collapse
signal: Answer treats zoning and private covenant as same.
student_move: Separate public permission from private restriction.
trap: Public permission defeats private burden.

title: Easement / License / Servitude Classifier
signal: Survivors disagree over right type.
student_move: Identify source instrument and benefit/burden relationship.
trap: True rule for one category applied to another.

title: Scope / Overuse Pair
signal: Finalists agree right exists but disagree scope.
student_move: Compare original source/scope to current burden.
trap: Existence of right treated as unlimited use.

title: Private Restriction / HOA / Zoning Pair
signal: Choices fight over enforceability of land-use rule.
student_move: Identify private covenant/common scheme/HOA/zoning.
trap: Public permission or HOA authority overgeneralized.

title: Classification Before Enforcement
signal: Choices mix right type, source, running, scope, termination, remedy.
student_move: Right type → source → burden/benefit → scope → termination → remedy.
trap: Remedy belongs to different right type.
confidence: HARD for sequence; ANCHOR-ASSISTED for rule

title: Private Ordering Beats General Use Permission
signal: Zoning permission vs private restriction.
student_move: Ask whether private covenant/servitude/common scheme binds party.
trap: Government permission confused with freedom from private burden.

title: Use-Right Floor
signal: Parallel answer array.
student_move: Apply use-right anchor.
trap: Calling license/support/no-light-view/relocation/fixtures structure.

title: Recording Before Valid Transfer
signal: Answer jumps to recording before deed validity/delivery/grantee.
student_move: Ask whether title ever validly left grantor.
trap: Recorded first sounds dispositive.
confidence: HARD for chain order; ANCHOR-ASSISTED for deed rule

title: Delivery Intent, Not Physical Handoff
signal: Answer treats physical deed transfer as conclusive.
student_move: Look for present intent to transfer ownership now.
trap: Ordinary delivery replaces legal delivery.

title: Protected-Party Inflation
signal: Answer treats party as protected because later, recorded, or no actual notice.
student_move: Require value + no notice + statute fit.
trap: Later purchaser/mortgagee/judgment creditor assumed BFP.

title: BFP / Not BFP
signal: Finalists disagree over later party protection.
student_move: Fill BFP grid.
trap: No actual notice treated as enough.

title: Valid Deed / No Valid Deed
signal: Finalists disagree whether transfer worked.
student_move: Check formalities, delivery, capacity, ID before priority.
trap: Recording/possession/fairness skips defective deed link.
confidence: HARD for chain order; ANCHOR-ASSISTED for exact rule

title: Notice / No Notice
signal: Choices fight over actual/inquiry/record notice.
student_move: Identify notice source.
trap: Notice treated as only actual notice.

title: First Effective Link Controls
signal: Choices debate later priority despite earlier defect.
student_move: Valid deed → delivery → grantee/capacity → value → notice → statute → recording → remedy.
trap: Starts at recording act because choices sound priority-based.
confidence: HARD for order; ANCHOR-ASSISTED for link rules

title: Recording Grid
signal: Choices contain race/notice/race-notice/BFP/judgment creditor/inquiry notice.
student_move: Use grid before ranking answers.
trap: Race-notice applied to notice statute; recording order always dispositive.

title: Title-Transfer Floor
signal: Parallel well-formed answer array.
student_move: Escalate to deed validity, delivery, grantee ID, dead grantee, escrow, agency.
trap: Calling deed formality structure.

title: AP / Warranty / Insurance Floor
signal: Choices turn on AP period, deed covenants, title insurance scope.
student_move: Apply small anchor.
trap: One AP element or warranty word treated as whole answer.
